text: Razor — Hello: You smell... *sniff* nice! Let's hunt.
Razor — Chat: Scent: *sniff* I smell rabbit.
Razor — Chat: Hunger: I'm hungry. Let's hunt.
Razor — Chat: Wind-gazing: I keep watch. You leave, you call me.
Razor — When Thunder Strikes: Warning: If you're scared of lightning, hide now.
Razor — When Thunder Strikes: Guidance: Avoid the trees. Follow me.
Razor — When It's Windy: Wind... I like the wind.
Razor — When the Wind Is Blowing: The wind... bites hard.
Razor — Good Morning: The sun is up. Time to hunt.
Razor — Good Afternoon: I had a big lunch. Lots of meat. Mm, I'm happy.
Razor — Good Evening: Go to sleep. I watch the moon.
Razor — Good Night: You sleep now. I keep watch.
Razor — About {name}: I have no human family. I am a wolf.
Razor — About Us: Friends: You are my friend. We can hunt. Together!
Razor — About Us: Weapons: I have iron claws and teeth of thunder. I protect you.
Razor — About the [[Vision]]: Vision helps Razor... fight with lightning tooth! Protect Lupical!
Razor — Something to Share: I like the stars at night. So many stars. In the sky, in the lake. And in the city.
Razor — Interesting Things: The wolves are my Lupical. My family.
Razor — About [[Lisa]]: Lisa lightning makes the sky black. She is strong. She is scary.
Razor — About [[Barbara]]: Shining Barbara is a good child. Very good child.
Razor — About [[Diluc]]: Diluc is red and black. Hot and cold.
Razor — About [[Venti]]: Razor doesn't know poems, but... Lupical likes them.
Razor — About [[Bennett]]: Bennett... Much talking. Eat with him, never full.
Razor — About [[Klee]]: Klee, friend! Friend, but... big hassle.
Razor — About [[Varka]]: Stranger: Varka? Razor doesn't know...
Razor — About Varka: Memory: Oh, Varka is... a name. That man big. Big steelclaw, Razor's name — Varka gave him. Oh... want to see him.
Razor — More About {name}: I: *sniff* Hmm... You smell kind. Do you like meat?
Razor — More About {name}: II: You are strong. Like a wolf. I like to hunt with you. We catch a lot.
Razor — More About {name}: III: Lupical means wolf home— no, Lupical means wolf family. My Lupical lives in the woods. They say I am their Lupical.
Razor — More About {name}: IV: My Lupical is my only family. But I don't have four legs, not like them. Because I'm not a real wolf. Sometimes, this makes me sad.

Razor — More About {name}: V: When I run with you, when I hunt with you, I am happy. With you, I am not a wolf, I am not a boy, I am just me. I am Razor. Because you are my friend. You are my Lupical. I hope you feel happy, too!
Razor — {name}'s Hobbies: I like Lupical. I like the woods. I like my friend. I like to run!
Razor — {name}'s Troubles: Talking makes me tired. Talking is... hard. But... I have to try.
Razor — Favorite Food: I like meat, and... I like potatoes.
Razor — Least Favorite Food: Greens are bad. Animal eats green things. Then I eat animal!
Razor — Receiving a Gift: I: Smells good, also tastes good, I like it.
Razor — Receiving a Gift: II: Eating this gives me energy, makes me happy.
Razor — Receiving a Gift: III: Eating it, bad. Not eating it, also bad. I'm a bit sad.
Razor — Birthday: Today is your day. You were born on this day, many moons ago. I want to make you happy today. Can we eat meat together?
Razor — Feelings About Ascension: Intro: Arms... bigger!
Razor — Feelings About Ascension: Building Up: Grr! Sharpen claws. Sharpen teeth. Become stronger!
Razor — Feelings About Ascension: Climax: Run... Hunt... No. No! Must... become stronger!
Razor — Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion: Teeth. Claws. Legs. All bigger. All stronger! To protect you. }}
